name: Payroll Processing
description: Implements payroll-related entities and processes including salary, deductions, tax calculations, and payslip generation.
outputPattern: Payroll model, API routes, and payroll service
systemPromptAddition:
## Payroll Skill
- Payroll cycle: monthly, bi-weekly, weekly
- Components: grossSalary, deductions[], netSalary, taxAmount
- Deduction types: tax, insurance, pension, loan, other
- Payslip includes: employee, period, earnings, deductions, net
- Use decimal for money (never float)
- Include audit trail for all payroll changes
